subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: What permanent public budget semantics should OpenClaw expose for runaway agent loops before the linked implementation is refreshed?
rationale: Counted unit, scope, defaults, and exhaustion behavior change agent execution and message delivery, so code inspection cannot safely choose them without maintainer intent.

options.title: Canonical opt-in budget
options.body: Define an opt-in default/per-agent contract with one tool-round counter, an optional separate total-call counter, explicit subagent precedence, and a final-summary exhaustion path.

options.title: Recovery timeout only
options.body: Decline count-based limits and treat stuck-session abort plus heuristic loop detection as the supported safeguards, accepting that varied rapid tool calls remain uncapped.

options.title: Pause the config surface
options.body: Keep the issue open for design but close or pause the current PR until a narrower API and runtime ownership model is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Canonical opt-in budget
recommendation.body: Define an opt-in default/per-agent contract with one tool-round counter, an optional separate total-call counter, explicit subagent precedence, and a final-summary exhaustion path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal combines prior issue review with merged tool-loop and agent-core history.
